messages:
Rae Kim: Quick thread — Neoteric Systems case draft is in Drive (transcript + audio). They want multi-region marketing: UK/DE/FR localized social + landing page. Need legal release, translation checks, and lead routing. Target publish: 2026-12-03 10:00 PT (embargo).
Owen Blake: I'll own customer quote sign-off and landing copy. Uploaded a hero quote draft: "Redwood reduced our inference latency and let us bring personalized search to customers faster." Sending to Neoteric now.
Sana Iqbal: Creative ETA: once translations are confirmed I can prepare hero image, 4 social sizes per locale, and 3 promo clips (15s/30s/60s). Also can add localized CTAs. Need final approved copy + screenshots.
LegalBot: Legal review required for release + benchmark language. Benchmarks must be phrased as "approximately Xx" or "approximately X%" and cite internal test ID NS-2026-88. Also require signed release per marketing template.
Rae Kim: Engineering numbers: ~2.0x median latency improvement on their production workload and ~22% lower cost per token. Marketing phrasing approved: "approximately 2.0x median latency improvement" and "approximately 22% lower cost per token." Please cite NS-2026-88.
Owen Blake: Customer replied: approves quote with small tweak to avoid "customer" -> use "users". New hero quote: "Redwood reduced our inference latency and helped us deliver personalized search to users faster." They also signed the release and uploaded it to Drive.
Marta Ruiz: Ops note: I'll create HubSpot form with tag "neoteric-case-2026" and set lead routing to the EU AE pool for localized follow-up. Recommend gating the one-pager per locale to collect qualification fields.
LegalBot: Release received and verified. Uploaded to legal repo: https://legal.redwood.internal/releases/neoteric/RELEASE_4112345910.pdf. Legal approves publication with the phrasing Rae provided and recommends removing any region-specific performance comparisons. Translations must be checked for fidelity to avoid implying stronger claims than the English copy.
Sana Iqbal: I'll queue localization tasks with translation vendor. ETA for translated copy and social text: Tue 11/30 EOD. Once translations are back, I'll layout per-locale social cards and schedule final export.
Owen Blake: Posting landing draft for customer preview by Fri 12/01. Will include benchmark callout + brief methodology blurb referencing NS-2026-88. Also adding a short FAQ about methodology for transparency.
Marta Ruiz: HubSpot routing configured with UTMs and locale-specific thank-you pages. Webinar slot: Neoteric signed up for a 12-minute segment on 2026-12-08; I'll add them to the webinar invite and mark leads who register as "webinar-interest".
Rae Kim: Embargo noted. Final publish process: customer preview -> legal final check -> localized asset upload -> publish at 2026-12-03 10:00 PT. Thanks team — please drop final links and signed files here when ready. :rocket:
